item.title: 不止每字母两字节：斯拉夫文字 AI 系统中的分词开销
item.summary: arXiv:2608.21384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern multilingual tokenizers often fragment Ukrainian and other underrepresented Cyrillic-script languages more heavily than English, creating disparities in cost and context capacity.
